answer: The registry attaches an influence seat to only one signing vertex. Claiming it takes a unique task hashed from that vertex and the epoch seed plus a 50-unit lock; success mints one non-transferable opal as the seat. Three graders re-solve that task within four hours; a mismatch, reuse, or paste burns the lock and voids the opal, so the next fake pays 50 units and new work. Each new opal stays in tundra for two epochs with no vote, letting peers flag copies before weight vests. Hired help cannot move one opal onto a second vertex. Limit: grader delay slows vesting, not per-key cost.
